name: opensre
description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
one_liner: An AI agent that reads your broken CI pipeline, figures out why it failed, and proposes a fix for a human to review — instead of an engineer losing an hour staring at logs.
buyer: An engineering lead at a mid-size company tired of engineers burning time debugging flaky or broken CI runs.
business_use_cases: An engineering team self-hosts it so failed test runs come with a draft fix PR attached, cutting mean-time-to-green.
A DevOps consultancy offers 'CI reliability as a service' to clients, running this agent against their pipelines.
A platform team uses it to triage flaky-test noise automatically so humans only review real failures.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed/hosted version with support for teams who don't want to self-host, priced per seat or per repo.
Sell implementation and tuning services to get it working well on a company's specific CI setup.

steal_this: Offer a free 1-week 'CI health audit' to three startups using this tool, then convert the ones with painful flaky-test problems into a paid setup engagement.
